env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd s
! logos build ./d
stderr 'Maybe\(true\) is dropped'
logos build ./e
cd ..

cd s/c
logos build -o $WORK/s.a .
cd ../..
go tool pack p $WORK/s.a __.LOGOS
stdout '^fn Control AlwaysNilError$'
! stdout '^fn Maybe AlwaysNilError'
cd ..

-- s/go.mod --
module example.com/s

go 1.27

-- s/c/c.lgo --
package c

import "errors"

var errBad = errors.New("bad")

func Maybe(fail bool) error {
	if fail {
		return errBad
	}
	return nil
}

func Control() error {
	return nil
}

-- s/d/d.lgo --
package d

import "example.com/s/c"

func Use() {
	c.Maybe(true)
}

-- s/e/e.lgo --
package e

import "example.com/s/c"

func Use() {
	c.Control()
}
